description:
Auris Payroll provides full-service payroll and HR support for businesses across all 50 states, designed to simplify compliance, reduce risk, and give business owners true peace of mind. With over 20 years of experience as an HR Director, I bring deep, hands-on knowledge of payroll administration, multi-state employment compliance, and people operations across a wide range of industries.

We manage accurate payroll processing, direct deposits, and payroll tax calculations, filings, and payments at the federal, state, and local levels—ensuring our clients remain compliant no matter where their employees are located. Beyond payroll, Auris Payroll supports businesses with employee onboarding, new hire reporting, wage and hour compliance, workers’ compensation coordination, garnishment administration, and unemployment and paid-leave reporting. We also provide guidance on HR best practices, employee classification, and navigating ever-changing employment regulations nationwide. In addition, we help create and update policies, procedures, and employee handbooks to support compliant and well-structured workplaces.

While we proudly serve clients throughout the United States, Auris Payroll is rooted in strong values. I have been a member of St. Peter the Rock Catholic Church in Monument, Colorado for 11 years, and my Catholic faith is a guiding foundation in both my personal and professional life. It shapes how I serve others—with integrity, accountability, compassion, and a commitment to doing what is right.

Our approach is relationship-driven and highly personalized. We act as an extension of your business, offering proactive communication, trusted expertise, and dependable service. At RS Payroll, clients aren’t just accounts—they’re partners—and we are honored to support their businesses with precision, care, and values you can trust.
